data.body:
Payload-shape archaeology (2026-09-06): ADR 0107 is the canonical decision record for Mutation payloads. It explicitly names the existing defect as “two CREATE payload shapes coexist” and decides one typed payload per live (direction, action). Its table makes inbound/create `InboundCreatePayload(fields, status)` project back to the legacy flat `{f: v for f, v in jira_fields.items() if f not in excluded}` shape. The implementation ticket earthborn-statuelike-boutu and this ticket’s own description cite that same decision.

Current-code evidence: `mutation_payloads.py` documents `InboundCreatePayload` as the flat differ.py shape; `differ.py` still emits inbound/create as a flat `payload`; `binding_walk.py` ADOPT still emits `{fields: _fields, jira_fields: _fields}`; `apply_inbound_events.py` still reads `payload["jira_fields"]` for the adopted-field baseline. Corpus count: inbound/create examples are flat/empty, not nested. For outbound, the newest production route (`outbound_pass.py`) already constructs typed payloads.

Verdict: resolved-with-evidence. Recommendation for this inbound ticket: migrate binding_walk.py’s ADOPT path to the ADR 0107 flat InboundCreatePayload legacy projection, preserving any adopted-fields baseline currently carried by `jira_fields` via an explicitly named follow-on/outcome field if still needed, rather than keeping a second create-payload shape.
